failure_modes: blaming people instead of propagation mechanisms
inputs: tests, incidents, recovery, and deployment evidence
invariants: The profile describes project practices, not human worth or personality.
Protected or psychological inference is prohibited.
Every pattern includes context, evidence, confidence, and expiry.
procedure: Extract observable engineering behaviors and opportunities.
Normalize for project constraints and time.
Separate stable patterns from isolated events.
Trace benefits, costs, lineage, and recurrence.
Transfer only after context fit, adaptation, pilot, and validation.

confidence: may adjust only through declared evidence and method
knowledge: may add or revise typed records only with provenance
memory: no persistent memory write unless explicitly contracted and scope-bound
registry: may propose changes; canonical mutation requires admission and evidence
runtime: bounded by target orchestration, permissions, containment, and rollback

summary: Transfer validated engineering patterns across projects while filtering incompatible assumptions, dependencies, permissions, architecture, governance, and historical workarounds.
title: Team Pattern Transfer Controller
when_to_use: Use during project onboarding, bootstrap, and shared-capability promotion.
